content: {"question":"How do I remove a team member from Navan Expense?","answer":"Log in to Navan Expense, go to Settings, select the appropriate policy, then remove the person from the People list.","evidence":"Log in to [Navan Expense](https://app.navan.com/app/liquid/) and go to \"Settings\" in the left sidebar. Select the right policy based upon the entity that employs the team member. Select \"People\" in the left menu. Select the individual's name and click \"Remove\"."}
